workbench.name: Solid Design
workbench.tooltip: Model parts the SolidWorks way, multi-body from the start

commands.name: SD_Part
commands.label: Part
commands.tooltip: Creates a part with its origin, default planes and body folders.

commands.name: SD_Sketch
commands.label: Sketch
commands.tooltip: Sketches on the selected plane or planar face.

commands.name: SD_Extrude
commands.label: Extrude
commands.tooltip: Extrudes a sketch or selected sketch contours in one or two directions to add material, or to cut it (Add | Cut in the panel).
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_Revolve
commands.label: Revolve
commands.tooltip: Revolves a sketch or selected sketch contours around an axis to add material, or to cut it (Add | Cut in the panel).
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_Sweep
commands.label: Sweep
commands.tooltip: Sweeps a profile along a path to add material, or to cut it (Add | Cut in the panel).
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_Loft
commands.label: Loft
commands.tooltip: Adds or cuts material between two or more profiles (Add | Cut in the panel).
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_Boundary
commands.label: Boundary
commands.tooltip: Adds or cuts material through curves in one or two directions (Add | Cut in the panel); with curves both ways the shape passes through the whole network.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_ExtrudedSurface
commands.label: Extruded Surface
commands.tooltip: Extrudes a sketch's curves (open or closed) into a surface body. Surface in the feature's Add | Cut | Surface switch.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_RevolvedSurface
commands.label: Revolved Surface
commands.tooltip: Revolves a sketch's curves around an axis into a surface body. Surface in the feature's Add | Cut | Surface switch.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_SweptSurface
commands.label: Swept Surface
commands.tooltip: Sweeps a profile's curves along a path into a surface body. Surface in the feature's Add | Cut | Surface switch.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_LoftedSurface
commands.label: Lofted Surface
commands.tooltip: Makes a surface body between two or more profiles. Surface in the feature's Add | Cut | Surface switch.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_BoundarySurface
commands.label: Boundary Surface
commands.tooltip: Makes a surface body through curves in one or two directions. Surface in the feature's Add | Cut | Surface switch.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_Shell
commands.label: Shell
commands.tooltip: Hollows a body, leaving open the faces you pick, with walls of the given thickness.
commands.doc: Fillet, Chamfer: preselected edges and faces fill the panel.

commands.name: SD_Rib
commands.label: Rib
commands.tooltip: Grows a wall of material from open sketch lines until it meets the model: in the sketch plane, or out of it.
commands.doc: A sketch-based Add | Cut tool (Extrude, Revolve). Opens in Add mode.

commands.name: SD_Draft
commands.label: Draft
commands.tooltip: Tapers faces by an angle so the part releases from a mould: about a neutral plane, or about parting lines.
commands.doc:
Draft: preselected faces are the faces to draft; a preselected plane is
    the neutral plane (SolidWorks takes both).

commands.name: SD_Thread
commands.label: Thread
commands.tooltip: Models a helical thread on a shaft or in a hole, starting at a circular edge: cut into it, or grown out of it.
commands.doc: Thread: a preselected circular edge is where it starts.

commands.name: SD_OffsetSurface
commands.label: Offset Surface
commands.tooltip: Offsets faces or surfaces by a distance into a new surface body (0: a copy).
commands.doc: Offset Surface, Move Face: preselected faces fill the panel.

commands.name: SD_SplitLine
commands.label: Split Line
commands.tooltip: Splits faces into more faces, without changing the body: by a projected sketch, where planes cut them, or along their silhouette.
commands.doc:
Split Line: preselected faces are the faces to split; a selected sketch is
    projected (Projection).

commands.name: SD_MoveFace
commands.label: Move Face
commands.tooltip: Moves faces of a solid (offset, translate or rotate); the faces around them extend or trim to follow.
commands.doc: Offset Surface, Move Face: preselected faces fill the panel.

commands.name: SD_Fillet
commands.label: Fillet
commands.tooltip: Creates a rounded internal or external face along one or more edges.
commands.doc: Fillet, Chamfer: preselected edges and faces fill the panel.

commands.name: SD_Chamfer
commands.label: Chamfer
commands.tooltip: Creates a bevel on selected edges, faces or a vertex.
commands.doc: Fillet, Chamfer: preselected edges and faces fill the panel.

commands.name: SD_ProjectedCurve
commands.label: Projected Curve
commands.tooltip: Projects a sketch onto faces, or makes the curve where two sketches on crossing planes meet.
commands.doc: Insert > Curve: a curve in the history (reference geometry, not a body).

commands.name: SD_CompositeCurve
commands.label: Composite Curve
commands.tooltip: Joins edges and sketch curves end to end into one curve.
commands.doc: Insert > Curve: a curve in the history (reference geometry, not a body).

commands.name: SD_CurveXYZ
commands.label: Curve Through XYZ Points
commands.tooltip: A smooth curve through points you type.
commands.doc: Insert > Curve: a curve in the history (reference geometry, not a body).

commands.name: SD_CurvePoints
commands.label: Curve Through Reference Points
commands.tooltip: A smooth curve through vertices and reference points.
commands.doc: Insert > Curve: a curve in the history (reference geometry, not a body).

commands.name: SD_Combine
commands.label: Combine
commands.tooltip: Combines bodies: adds them, subtracts some from a main body, or keeps what they have in common.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_DeleteBody
commands.label: Delete/Keep Body
commands.tooltip: Deletes the selected bodies, or keeps only them.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Split
commands.label: Split
commands.tooltip: Splits bodies with planes, faces, surface bodies or sketches into separate bodies.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_MoveCopy
commands.label: Move/Copy Body
commands.tooltip: Moves or copies bodies by a translation and a rotation.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_LinearPattern
commands.label: Linear Pattern
commands.tooltip: Repeats features or bodies in one or two directions.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_CircularPattern
commands.label: Circular Pattern
commands.tooltip: Repeats features or bodies around an axis.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Mirror
commands.label: Mirror
commands.tooltip: Mirrors features or bodies about a face or plane.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_CurvePattern
commands.label: Curve Driven Pattern
commands.tooltip: Repeats features or bodies along a curve.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_SketchPattern
commands.label: Sketch Driven Pattern
commands.tooltip: Repeats features or bodies at a sketch's points.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_TablePattern
commands.label: Table Driven Pattern
commands.tooltip: Repeats features or bodies at X, Y positions you type in.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_FillPattern
commands.label: Fill Pattern
commands.tooltip: Fills a face with features, or with cuts of a simple shape, in rows or rings.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_VariablePattern
commands.label: Variable Pattern
commands.tooltip: Repeats a feature with its dimensions changed per instance, from a table: position, size or depth.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_HoleWizard
commands.label: Hole Wizard
commands.tooltip: Inserts holes of a standard type and size at points on a face or a sketch.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Knit
commands.label: Knit Surface
commands.tooltip: Knits surfaces into one; closed, it can become a solid.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_PlanarSurface
commands.label: Planar Surface
commands.tooltip: Makes a flat surface inside a sketch's closed regions or closed, flat loops of edges.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_FilledSurface
commands.label: Filled Surface
commands.tooltip: Patches a closed loop of edges with a surface, touching or tangent to the faces around it.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_TrimSurface
commands.label: Trim Surface
commands.tooltip: Trims surfaces with a plane, sketch or surface, or with each other; click the pieces to keep or remove.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_ExtendSurface
commands.label: Extend Surface
commands.tooltip: Extends a surface past its open edges, on the same surface or straight on.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_DeleteFace
commands.label: Delete Face
commands.tooltip: Deletes faces: leaves a gap (the body becomes a surface), heals it from the faces around, or fills it.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Intersect
commands.label: Intersect
commands.tooltip: Makes solid bodies from the regions where solids, surfaces and planes meet; exclude the regions you don't want.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Dome
commands.label: Dome
commands.tooltip: Adds a dome (or a dent) on flat faces.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Wrap
commands.label: Wrap
commands.tooltip: Wraps a sketch onto a cylindrical or flat face: emboss, deboss or scribe it.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_RuledSurface
commands.label: Ruled Surface
commands.tooltip: Strips standing off edges: tangent or normal to the faces, or at an angle to a direction.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_RadiateSurface
commands.label: Radiate Surface
commands.tooltip: A surface spreading outward from edges, parallel to a plane (a parting surface).
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_UntrimSurface
commands.label: Untrim Surface
commands.tooltip: A face back to the surface it lies on: holes filled, or grown past its edges.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_MidSurface
commands.label: Mid-Surface
commands.tooltip: Surfaces midway between the two sides of thin walls.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_SurfaceCut
commands.label: Cut With Surface
commands.tooltip: Cuts bodies with a surface or plane, keeping one side.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_ReplaceFace
commands.label: Replace Face
commands.tooltip: Replaces faces of a solid with a surface: the solid grows out to it or is trimmed back.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Flex
commands.label: Flex
commands.tooltip: Bends, twists, tapers or stretches bodies along an axis.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Scale
commands.label: Scale
commands.tooltip: Scales bodies about their centre, the origin or a coordinate system.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Deform
commands.label: Deform
commands.tooltip: Pushes a point, moves curves onto others, or pushes a tool body in, and the body follows smoothly.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Indent
commands.label: Indent
commands.tooltip: Presses a tool body's shape into a target body, with a wall round it, or cuts it in.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Freeform
commands.label: Freeform
commands.tooltip: Pushes or pulls a face at points you place on it; its edges stay put.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_SurfaceFlatten
commands.label: Surface Flatten
commands.tooltip: Lays faces out flat as a new surface body.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_MountingBoss
commands.label: Mounting Boss
commands.tooltip: Adds a round boss on a face, with a hole or a pin and optional fins: click where it goes.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_SnapHook
commands.label: Snap Hook
commands.tooltip: Adds a snap hook (a beam with a catch on its tip) on a face: click where it goes.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_LipGroove
commands.label: Lip/Groove
commands.tooltip: Where two bodies meet on a flat face, grows a lip out of one and cuts a matching groove in the other.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Vent
commands.label: Vent
commands.tooltip: Cuts a vent from a sketch: its outer loop opens the wall, its lines stay as ribs and its inner loops as spars.
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Thicken
commands.label: Thicken
commands.tooltip: Thickens a surface body into a solid, or cuts the solids with it (Add | Cut in the panel).
commands.doc: A feature command that fills its panel from the selection.

commands.name: SD_Plane
commands.label: Plane
commands.tooltip: Adds a reference plane.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_Axis
commands.label: Axis
commands.tooltip: Adds a reference axis.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_Point
commands.label: Point
commands.tooltip: Adds a reference point: an arc's centre, a face's centre, where an edge meets a face, a projection, or a distance along an edge.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_CoordinateSystem
commands.label: Coordinate System
commands.tooltip: Adds a coordinate system from an origin and X and Y directions (all optional). Sketches can be attached to it.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_Helix
commands.label: Helix/Spiral
commands.tooltip: Adds a helix or spiral from a circle (a sketch with one circle, or a circular edge): a path for springs and threads.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_BoundingBox
commands.label: Bounding Box
commands.tooltip: Adds a box round the bodies: the smallest one, or one square to a plane. Its length, width and thickness follow the model.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_CosmeticThread
commands.label: Cosmetic Thread
commands.tooltip: Shows a thread on a shaft or in a hole without modelling it: pick the circular edge where it starts.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_CenterOfMass
commands.label: Center of Mass
commands.tooltip: Adds a point at the solid bodies' centre of mass; it follows the model and can be used like any point.
commands.doc:
Plane, Axis: the type is guessed from what is preselected (as SolidWorks
    guesses its constraints).

commands.name: SD_ReferenceGeometry
commands.label: Reference Geometry
commands.tooltip: Adds reference geometry: a plane, an axis, a coordinate system, a point, a bounding box or the centre of mass.
commands.doc:
Reference Geometry: one toolbar button with a drop-down (SolidWorks' flyout),
    Plane first and the default.

commands.name: SD_Patterns
commands.label: Patterns
commands.tooltip: Repeats features, faces or bodies: in lines, round an axis, along a curve, at sketch points, from a table, or filling a face.
commands.doc: Linear Pattern with a drop-down of the other patterns (SolidWorks' flyout).

commands.name: SD_Curves
commands.label: Curves
commands.tooltip: Curves: split line, projected, composite, through points, helix/spiral.
commands.doc:
Insert > Curve as one toolbar button with a drop-down (SolidWorks' Curves
    flyout).

commands.name: SD_MoreSurfaces
commands.label: More Surfaces
commands.tooltip: Ruled, Radiate, Untrim, Mid-Surface and Surface Flatten.
commands.doc: The less used surface tools, in one drop-down.

commands.name: SD_DeformBodies
commands.label: Deform Bodies
commands.tooltip: Flex, Deform, Indent, Freeform or Scale bodies.

commands.name: SD_Fastening
commands.label: Fastening Features
commands.tooltip: Mounting boss, snap hook, lip/groove or vent.
commands.doc: Fastening Features: one toolbar button with a drop-down (SolidWorks' flyout).

commands.name: SD_Threads
commands.label: Threads
commands.tooltip: A modelled thread, or a cosmetic one.

commands.name: SD_CommandSearch
commands.label: Command Search
commands.tooltip: Find a Solid Design tool by typing its name, then press Enter to start it.
commands.doc: The "/" key: Solid Design's command search.

commands.name: SD_CommandLine
commands.label: Command Line
commands.tooltip: Type a tool and its values, e.g. "fillet 2" (press : in the 3D view). Works on the selection, or what's under the pointer.

commands.name: SD_RepeatLast
commands.label: Repeat Last Feature
commands.tooltip: Make the last feature again with the same settings, on the selection or what's under the pointer (press . in the 3D view).

commands.name: SD_WhatsWrong
commands.label: What's Wrong
commands.tooltip: Lists what's wrong in the model, why, and what to do: shows each problem in the view and offers the fix.

commands.name: SD_Rebuild
commands.label: Force Rebuild
commands.tooltip: Rebuilds every feature from scratch.

commands.name: SD_ContextToolbar
commands.label: Context Toolbar
commands.tooltip: Shows the tools that fit a face, edge or vertex by the pointer when you click it.
commands.doc: Solid Design > Context Toolbar: on or off (kept between sessions).

commands.name: SD_ReferenceLabels
commands.label: Reference Names
commands.tooltip: Shows the names of planes, axes, points and coordinate systems in the 3D view.
commands.doc: Solid Design > Reference Names: on or off (kept between sessions).
